questions.question: What was my longest guitar session in minutes?
questions.answer: Your longest guitar session lasted 25 minutes.
questions.sql:
SELECT MAX(duration_minutes) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM guitar_sessions

questions.question: What's my average guitar session length?
questions.answer: Your average guitar session length is 7 minutes.
questions.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS avg_duration_minutes
FROM guitar_sessions

questions.question: How many books am I currently reading?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS books_reading
FROM books
WHERE status = 'reading'

questions.question: Which book have I spent the most time reading?
questions.answer: You have spent the most time reading Atomic Habits, with a total of 15 minutes.
questions.sql:
SELECT b.title, SUM(rs.duration_minutes) AS total_reading_time
FROM books b
JOIN reading_sessions rs ON b.id = rs.book_id
GROUP BY b.id, b.title
ORDER BY total_reading_time DESC
LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many pages have I read in total?
questions.answer: You have read a total of 669 pages.
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(pages_read) AS total_pages
FROM reading_sessions

questions.question: How many LeetCode problems have I solved?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS solved_count
FROM leetcode_problems
WHERE solved = true

questions.question: How many Hard LeetCode problems are still unsolved?
questions.answer: You have 5 unsolved Hard LeetCode problems.
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unsolved_hard_problems
FROM leetcode_problems
WHERE difficulty = 'Hard'
  AND solved = false

questions.question: How many LeetCode problems did I solve in September 2026?
questions.answer: You solved 25 LeetCode problems in September 2026.
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS solved_count
FROM leetcode_problems
WHERE solved_date >= '2026-09-01'
  AND solved_date < '2026-10-01'
  AND solved = true

questions.question: How many tasks did I complete last month?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_tasks
FROM tasks
WHERE task_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') + INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND task_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
  AND completed = true

questions.question: How many high-priority tasks do I have this week?
questions.answer: You have 11 high-priority tasks this week.
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_priority_tasks
FROM tasks
WHERE priority = 1
  AND task_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
  AND task_date < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '7 days'

questions.question: On which day did I practise guitar the most?
questions.answer: You practiced guitar the most on September 12, 2026, with a total of 27 minutes across 3 sessions.
questions.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS practice_day,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       SUM(duration_minutes) AS total_minutes
FROM guitar_sessions
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at)
ORDER BY total_minutes DESC
LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is my best reading streak?
questions.answer: Your best reading streak is 3 days.
questions.sql:
SELECT MAX(best_count) AS best_reading_streak
FROM streaks
WHERE habit_type = 'reading'

questions.question: How many notes do I have?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS note_count
FROM notes

questions.question: How many recurring event series are on my calendar?
questions.answer: You have 6 recurring event series on your calendar.
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT series_id) AS recurring_series_count
FROM tasks
WHERE recurrence IS NOT NULL AND recurrence != ''

questions.question: Show my reading minutes per week this month
questions.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', session_date) AS week_start,
       SUM(duration_minutes) AS reading_minutes
FROM reading_sessions
WHERE session_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
  AND session_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY date_trunc('week', session_date)
ORDER BY week_start
